_doc: Setne's Tomb (DEEDS_KARMA_DESIGN 11.12; ENCOUNTER_STORIES_DRAFT H00 and C19). Engine settings and engine lines for src/setne_tomb.py. The encounter itself (the scene, the senet quiz with per_miss, the oath thoth_return, the forgo, the schedule of the dead) is ordinary encounter data under the tag in 'encounter', marked callback_only so nothing else rolls it: this system places it in a sealed tomb room on one run-rolled floor. The Book of Thoth has no other source.
atmosphere: The air on this floor is heavy with the smell of river mud and myrrh.
door_message: A door of black stone that was never meant to open swings inward at your touch.
read_spent_message: The words remain upon the page, but they will not work their wonder a second time.

altar.unread_message: It is too soon to lay it here, for you swore that you would read it first.
altar.on_time_message: The book is wet when you lay it down, though it was dry in your pack. When next you look it is gone, and the altar smells of the river.
altar.on_time_chronicle: Laid the Book of Thoth on an altar, as sworn to the prince. It had gone home.
altar.late_message: Late as you come, the book is wet when you lay it down, and for a moment you hear a woman say a child's name.
altar.late_thread_line: Took the Book of Thoth back late. Heard a woman say a child's name.
altar.late_chronicle: Laid the Book of Thoth on an altar, later than sworn. It still went home.
